thread.title: Investment Analysts’ Downgrades for January, 17th (AAPL, ABB, ADNT, AETUF, AMGP, BFR, CLR, COG, DISH, DKL)

author: Stephan Byrd
title: Investment Analysts’ Downgrades for January, 17th (AAPL, ABB, ADNT, AETUF, AMGP, BFR, CLR, COG, DISH, DKL)
text:
Investment Analysts’ downgrades for Wednesday, January 17th: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by analysts at Longbow Research from a buy rating to a neutral rating. Get Apple Inc alerts: 
ABB (NYSE:ABB) was downgraded by analysts at Robert W. Baird from an outperform rating to a neutral rating. Adient (NYSE:ADNT) was downgraded by analysts at Robert W. Baird from an outperform rating to a neutral rating. 
Arc Resources (OTCMKTS:AETUF) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an overweight rating to an equal weight rating. 
Antero Midstream GP (NYSE:AMGP) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an overweight rating to a hold rating. They currently have $23.00 target price on the stock. 
BBVA Banco Frances (NYSE:BFR) was downgraded by analysts at Santander from a buy rating to a hold rating. 
Continental Resources (NYSE:CLR) was downgraded by analysts at UBS Group AG from a positive rating to a neutral rating. 
Cabot Oil & Gas (NYSE:COG) was downgraded by analysts at UBS Group AG from a positive rating to a neutral rating. 
DISH Network (NASDAQ:DISH) was downgraded by analysts at Morgan Stanley from an overweight rating to an equal weight rating. 
Delek Logistics Partners (NYSE:DKL) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an equal weight rating to a sell rating. The firm currently has $32.00 price target on the stock. 
Diana Shipping (NYSE:DSX) was downgraded by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. from an overweight rating to a hold rating. The firm currently has $5.00 target price on the stock. 
Energizer (NYSE:ENR) was downgraded by analysts at Citigroup Inc from a buy rating to a neutral rating. 
Ethan Allen Interiors (NYSE:ETH) was downgraded by analysts at Telsey Advisory Group from an outperform rating to a market perform rating. They currently have $27.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $33.00. 
Evertec (NYSE:EVTC) was downgraded by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc from a neutral rating to a sell rating. 
Aerohive Networks (NYSE:HIVE) was downgraded by analysts at Dougherty & Co from a buy rating to a neutral rating. 
HP (NYSE:HPQ) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an overweight rating to an equal weight rating. 
Juniper Networks (NYSE:JNPR) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an equal weight rating to an underweight rating. 
Martin Midstream Partners (NASDAQ:MMLP) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a strong sell rating. According to Zacks, “Martin Midstream is a limited partnership which stores and transports hydrocarbon products and specialty chemicals, primarily in the Gulf Coast. It runs a marine transportation business, mostly barges and tugs, and operates storage tanks. “ 
Manning and Napier (NYSE:MN) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a buy rating to a hold rating. According to Zacks, “Manning & Napier, Inc. operates as an investment advisor engaged in managing corporate and union pension and annuity funds, endowment funds, foundations, profit sharing plans and benefit plans. It offers equity and fixed income portfolios and a range of blended asset portfolios. The Company offers investment solutions through separately managed accounts, mutual funds, and collective investment trust funds. Manning & Napier, Inc. is headquartered in Fairport, New York. “ 
Moog (NYSE:MOG.A) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a buy rating to a hold rating. According to Zacks, “Moog, Inc. is a designer, manufacturer and integrator of precision motion, fluid controls and systems for applications in aerospace, defense and industrial markets. It operates through five segments: Aircraft Controls, Space and Defense Controls, Industrial Systems, Components and Medical Devices. The Aircraft Controls segment designs, manufactures and integrates primary and secondary flight controls for military and commercial aircraft and provides aftermarket support. The Space and Defense Controls segment provides controls for satellites and space vehicles, armored combat vehicles, tactical and strategic missiles, security and surveillance. The Industrial Systems segment designs and manufactures electric pitch controls and blade monitoring systems for wind turbines and also supplies electromechanical motion simulation bases. Its Components segment offers slip rings, fiber optic rotary joints and handpieces product line. Its Medical Devices segment focuses on infusion therapy & enteral clinical nutrition. “ 
Mplx (NYSE:MPLX) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an overweight rating to an equal weight rating. 
MicroStrategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a sell rating. According to Zacks, “MicroStrategy Incorporated, a leading worldwide provider of business intelligence software, today announced that GT Nexus has selected MicroStrategy to power the customer-facing analytics and reporting capabilities on its Global Logistics portal. The GT Nexus portal is an on demand technology platform that is used by importers, exporters, transportation carriers, suppliers, banks, and other partners to manage goods that are moving around the world. The GT Nexus system captures and stores hard-to-get data associated with global supply chains, and then fuels a range of Web applications that can be used by constituents to lower supply chain costs and improve control. MicroStrategy will help GT Nexus to deliver a wide range of analytics and reporting capabilities to its customers, which include Home Depot, Kmart, Xerox, Weyerhaeuser, and American Eagle Outfitters. “ 
MDXHealth (OTCMKTS:MXDHF) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a sell rating. According to Zacks, “MDxHealth SA is a healthcare company which provides actionable molecular diagnostic information for diagnosis and treatment of cancer. The company’s tests are based on proprietary gene methylation and other molecular technologies and assist physicians with the diagnosis of cancer. MDxHealth SA is headquartered in Herstal, Belgium. “ 
Nabors Industries (NYSE:NBR) was downgraded by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. from an overweight rating to a hold rating. JPMorgan Chase & Co. currently has $9.00 price target on the stock. 
Nextera Energy Partners (NYSE:NEP) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a sell rating. According to Zacks, “NextEra Energy Partners LP is engages in acquire, manage and own contracted clean energy projects. The company owns interests in wind and solar projects primarily in North America, as well as natural gas infrastructure assets in Texas. NextEra Energy Partners LP, formerly known as NextEra Energy, is based in Juno Beach, Florida. “ 
Norsk Hydro ASA (OTCMKTS:NHYDY) was downgraded by analysts at UBS Group AG from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
